Edit the supplied geometry-template image into ONE finished transparent PNG game-furniture pawn. The template is an edit target defining camera, ground-contact polygon and scale, not a style reference. Remove its background, markings, labels, grid and solid guide volume completely. Use the other supplied approved game images ONLY as style/material references: street thug = bold dark silhouette and lively hand-painted volume, toolbench = outline and wood/metal shading (DO NOT copy its circular pedestal), transit rack = reused contemporary industrial steel and repaired construction, mat = muted patched fabric. Exact orthographic game camera: horizontal ground axes slope +0.7071 and -0.7071, vertical posts straight vertical, no vanishing point. Native long direction and ground corners follow template. Keep generous transparent margin, entire object within image, no cropping. Painted 2.5D game art, bold near-black outer contour, thinner varied inner marks, broad sculpted shadow planes, light upper-left, warmer worn wood, desaturated olive padding and blue-gray iron, restrained rusty orange repairs. Distinct useful shapes, sparsely placed wear, not noisy scratches, not photo, not polished 3D, not vector icon. All equipment is functional salvaged modern gym apparatus in a resource-scarce hideout, visibly handmade/repaired but sturdy. Match the existing approved illustrations, no futuristic electronics.
SUBJECT: LEVEL 1 HAND EXERCISE KIT, sports equipment only. One small shallow wooden tray holding two portable squeeze-grip exercisers with rounded padded handles and curved metal springs, a rubber finger-stretch exercise ring and a small rounded thumb-pinch block. Ordinary gym hand-strength tools. No human body parts and no person. No tabletop or table legs, only the small removable kit. Tray follows template ground rectangle0.5x0.35cell, top14px worldheight. Simple first-level attachments with no adjustment dials.
